description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 28.10.2024 to 03.10.2024
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs valuation and financial compliance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory requirements for customs operations.
